post.description: This API lets you make payouts to bank accounts and mobile money wallets

sourceCurrency.description: The currency which is used to fund the  payout

destinationCurrency.description: The currency in which the recipient will be receiving funds

amount.description: The value that is to be transferred from the source currency wallet.

business.description: The unique Identifier of the parent business or sub account

customerReference.description: The transaction's unique identifier on your system. Customer references prevent duplicate transactions.

firstName.description: The first name of the beneficiary .

lastName.description: The last name of the beneficiary.

type.description: The type of beneficiary receiving the payout, which might be either an individual or a corporation.

accountHolderName.description: The name of the beneficiary on the bank account

accountNumber.description: The account number of the beneficiary(This means beneficiary phone number for Mobile money use case)

mobileMoneyCode.description: This is a unique Identifier of the beneficiary mobile money wallet

country.description: The country in which the bank of the beneficiary is located. This field should be according to  [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes](https://www.nationsonline.org/oneworld/country_code_list.htm) standards e.g NG, GB

bankCode.description: The bank code of the beneficiary's bank

bankSwiftCode.description: The bank swift code of the beneficiary

sortCode.description: The bank sort code of the beneficiary. This is required to process a payout to a bank in the United kingdom

registrationNumber.description: This field only applies to a EUR/GBP corporate beneficiary. A government institution provides the company's unique registration number.

countryOfResidence.description: The code of country according to ISO 3166-1 Alpha 2

document.description: The document needed to process the transaction

type.description: type of ID document e.g International Passport

issuedCountryCode.description: The country that issued the document.Should  be in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 – two-letter country codes format(NG)

issuedBy.description: The government agency in charge of issuing the document.

issuedDate.description: The date the document was issued("YYYY-MM-DD")

expirationDate.description: The expiration date on the document ("YYYY-MM-DD").

paymentDestination.description: This is the type of account you want to send your payments to e.g bank account, mobile money wallet

paymentScheme.description: The payment scheme relevant to the destination currency and region e.g sepa

quoteReference.description: This is the reference generated when the source currency is compared against the destination currency. This is compulsory for cross-currency payouts.

sender.description: The details of the customer initiating the payout

name.description: The customer's full name. This name would show up in the transfer narration.

amount.description: The amount to charge the customer

currency.description: The currency in which the customer should be charged e.g NGN,GHS,KES etc

type.description: This  payment type which can either be card, transfer, payattitude or mobile_money

name.description: The name of the customer in the format firstname and lastname e.g Ayo Ayobola

card.description: The details of the card you want to charge . This is required if "type" is card

card_number.description: The card number/PAN on the credit/debit card

cvv.description: The CVV on the credit/debit card

expiry_month.description: The expiry month on the credit/debit card

expiry_year.description: The expiry year on the credit/debit card

phone.description: The customer's payAttitude account phone number. This is required if "type" is payattitude or mobile_money

settlementDestination.description: A settlement destination is the location where you want your payments to be settled. It could be wallet or a bank account. Cards and bank transfer payments can be settled to wallet or bank accounts but payattitude and mobile money can be settled to just wallets.

callbackUrl.description: The URL to redirect your customer when the transaction is complete.It's the url of your payment page you want your users to return to after 3ds authorization. This field is compulsory for card payment
